title.zh: Gate创始人及CEO Dr.Han：一键开通全球银行同名账户，打通资产、资金与支付的边界
title.en: Gate创始人及CEO Dr.Han：一键开通全球银行同名账户，打通资产、资金与支付的边界

current_state.zh: Gate announced Gate Money at TOKEN2049 Singapore, letting eligible users open same-name global bank e-accounts tied to the exchange and move between fiat, digital assets, stocks, ETFs, gold and payments via the Gate App and Gate Card across 60+ local currencies.
